body:
Some thoughts on the topic:
 - the sort strategy depends on the number of facet values. If you have few, you probably want  something static because there is little to no risk that the value will disappear. The opposite is true, if you are likely to loose the values you probably want to keep them
 - what if displaying the selected values in the list is not important? What if we could display them on top of the list, without altering the order to fit the need to keep the selected values on sight?
